# ColorFYI Embed Widget

> Color conversion, WCAG contrast, 16.7M hex colors. Embeddable widgets for any website. Zero dependencies, Shadow DOM isolation.

## Quick Start

```html
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/colorfyi-embed@1/dist/embed.min.js"></script>
<div data-colorfyi="converter" data-slug="example"></div>
```

## Available Widget Types (11)

- entity: `data-colorfyi="entity"`
- glossary: `data-colorfyi="glossary"`
- guide: `data-colorfyi="guide"`
- compare: `data-colorfyi="compare"`
- search: `data-colorfyi="search"`
- converter (interactive): `data-colorfyi="converter"`
- contrast (interactive): `data-colorfyi="contrast"`
- harmony (interactive): `data-colorfyi="harmony"`
- colorblind (interactive): `data-colorfyi="colorblind"`
- shades (interactive): `data-colorfyi="shades"`
- swatch (interactive): `data-colorfyi="swatch"`

## Customization

- **Themes**: light, dark, sepia, auto (follows system preference)
- **Sizes**: compact (280px), default (420px), large (720px)
- **Styles**: modern, classic

```html
<div data-colorfyi="converter" data-slug="example"
     data-theme="auto" data-size="compact" data-style-variant="modern"></div>
```

## Integration Methods

1. **Script tag** (recommended): `<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/colorfyi-embed@1/dist/embed.min.js"></script>`
2. **iframe**: `https://colorfyi.com/iframe/entity/{slug}/`
3. **oEmbed**: `https://colorfyi.com/oembed?url={page_url}&format=json`
4. **Badge**: `https://colorfyi.com/badge/site.svg`
